caption: The drawing depicts a wooden structure composed of a vertical post mounted on an irregularly shaped wooden base, with a horizontal plank intersecting near the top of the post to form a T-shape. Attached to the intersecting planks is a circular metal hoop, positioned upright and secured at four points. Affixed equidistantly around the hoop are six small, flared metal bells with a greenish patina, each oriented outward. The wood is depicted in shades of brown with visible grain and slight irregularities, while the metal hoop and bells have mottled green and brown hues. The overall composition is centered on a plain, off-white background, and there is a handwritten signature in the lower right corner reading “Geoffrey Holt and Harry Mann Waddell.”
title: Altar Chimes
